findings.title: 32-bit TIME seconds wrap is unspecified
findings.description: RFC 868 returns a 32-bit unformatted binary number of seconds since 00:00 1 January 1900 GMT without stating wrap or era behavior.

evidence.quote: the time is the number of seconds since 00:00 (midnight) 1 January 1900 GMT

findings.machine_interpretation: Unsigned 32-bit seconds from 1900 wrap on a known horizon.
findings.recommendation_level1: Document wrap behavior and successor representations.
findings.scope_rationale: This matters to time assurance because a 32-bit seconds counter wraps on a known horizon.
